2763.sent:
// Detects KERNEL_* env-var with YAML-injection markers in EG application syslog or WAF body logs.
// CommonSecurityLog does NOT carry DeviceName — use DestinationHostName / SourceIP for host pivots.
let InjectionMarkers = @"(?i)KERNEL_[A-Z_]+[^\n]{0,200}(---|\.\.\.|securityContext|runAsUser|runAsGroup|fsGroup|privileged\s*:\s*true)";
union isfuzzy=true
(
  Syslog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where ProcessName has_any ("enterprise_gateway", "enterprise-gateway", "jupyter") or SyslogMessage has "/api/kernels"
  | where SyslogMessage matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="Syslog", Host=Computer, HostName, ProcessName, Evidence=SyslogMessage
),
(
  CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestURL has "/api/kernels" and RequestMethod =~ "POST"
  | where Message matches regex InjectionMarkers or DeviceCustomString1 matches regex InjectionMarkers or AdditionalExtensions matches regex InjectionMarkers
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="WAF/Proxy", Host=DestinationHostName, SourceIP=SourceIP, ProcessName=DeviceProduct, Evidence=coalesce(Message, DeviceCustomString1, AdditionalExtensions)
),
(
  W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csUriStem == "/api/kernels" and csMethod =~ "POST"
  | project TimeGenerated, Source="IIS", Host=Computer, SourceIP=cIP, ProcessName="w3wp", Evidence=strcat(csMethod, " ", csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery)
)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

status: experimental
description: Detects HTTP PATCH requests against the praisonai-platform /workspaces/{workspace_id}/members/{user_id} endpoint that exposes a vertical privilege-escalation primitive (CVE-2026-47416). The endpoint should normally see near-zero PATCH traffic; any successful PATCH is suspicious until the deployment is patched to >=0.1.3 with the min_role='owner' gate applied.

let Lookback = 7d;

description: Detects presence of vm2 npm module package.json on endpoints, indicating exposure to CVE-2026-47208 sandbox escape (vm2 <= 3.11.3).
references:
  - https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-76w7-j9cq-rx2j
  - https://github.com/patriksimek/vm2/security/advisories/GHSA-qvjj-29qf-hp7p
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\node_modules\vm2\package.json'
      - '/node_modules/vm2/package.json'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Developer workstations and CI build agents legitimately depending on vm2
  - Legacy applications pending migration to isolated-vm
level: medium
2875.spl: | tstats `summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name="package.json" Filesystem.file_path="*\\node_modules\\vm2\\package.json" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

2876.def:
// vm2 sandbox escape -> child_process.execSync spawns host process from node.exe
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "node.exe"
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bash.exe","sh.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","touch.exe","curl.exe","wget.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
| where not (InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("npm install","npm ci","npm run","yarn install","pnpm install","node-gyp","electron-builder","husky","postinstall"))
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentPath = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd  = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildPath  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd   = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc

2877.def:
// Hunts CVE-2026-47208 PoC fingerprint in node.exe cmdlines AND .js file drops
let poc_strings = dynamic([
    "constructor.constructor(\"return process\")",
    "constructor.constructor('return process')",
    "mainModule.require('child_process')",
    "mainModule.require(\"child_process\")",
    "Symbol.species"
]);
let cmdline_hits =
    DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName in~ ("node.exe","nodejs.exe")
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_any (poc_strings)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, Source = "cmdline",
              Evidence = ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let file_hits =
    DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where FileName endswith ".js" or FileName endswith ".mjs" or FileName endswith ".cjs"
    | where InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (poc_strings) or FolderPath has "vm2"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
              Source = "file",
              Evidence = strcat(FolderPath, "\\", FileName),
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
union cmdline_hits, file_hits
| order by Timestamp desc

2914.def:
// Yamcs runs as a JVM; web traffic to its REST API is usually proxied or visible as DeviceNetworkEvents to TCP/8090. Defender's HTTP-body visibility is limited — pair with the WAF/reverse-proxy log source.
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where RemotePort == 8090 or LocalPort == 8090
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("java.exe","java")
| where AdditionalFields has_any ("PATCH","/api/mdb/","/realtime/algorithms/")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, RemoteIP, RemotePort, LocalPort, AdditionalFields
| order by Timestamp desc
2914.sent:
// Detect HTTP PATCH to Yamcs MDB algorithms endpoint carrying Jython-to-Java escape strings.
let algoEndpoint = @"/api/mdb/[^/]+/realtime/algorithms/";
let jythonPayloadTokens = dynamic(["java.lang.Runtime","getRuntime","import java","Runtime.getRuntime","exec([\"bash\"","exec([\"sh\"","exec([\"cmd\""]);
union isfuzzy=true
(W3CIISLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where csMethod =~ "PATCH"
  | where csUriStem matches regex algoEndpoint
  | extend Src = cIP, User = csUserName, Uri = strcat(csUriStem, iff(isnotempty(csUriQuery), strcat("?", csUriQuery), "")), UA = csUserAgent, Body = ""
  | project TimeGenerated, Src, User, Uri, UA, Body, Status = scStatus),
(CommonSecurityLog
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where RequestMethod =~ "PATCH"
  | where RequestURL matches regex algoEndpoint
  | extend Src = SourceIP, User = SourceUserName, Uri = RequestURL, UA = RequestClientApplication, Body = coalesce(AdditionalExtensions, Message), Status = tostring(EventOutcome)
  | project TimeGenerated, Src, User, Uri, UA, Body, Status),
(ImWebSession
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
  | where HttpMethod =~ "PATCH"
  | where Url matches regex algoEndpoint
  | extend Src = SrcIpAddr, User = SrcUsername, Uri = Url, UA = HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, Body = "", Status = tostring(HttpStatusCode)
  | project TimeGenerated, Src, User, Uri, UA, Body, Status)
| where Body has_any (jythonPayloadTokens) or Uri has_any (jythonPayloadTokens)
| order by TimeGenerated desc

// Article-specific bespoke detection — Laravel Lang Supply Chain Advisory
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/run/secrets/") or FileName in~ ("debugchromium.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

2968.def:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let WindowMin = 1m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where FileName =~ "cat" or FolderPath endswith "/cat"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("/proc/1/environ","/.ssh/id_","/.kube/config","/.npmrc","/.docker/config.json")
| extend Target = case(
    ProcessCommandLine has "/proc/1/environ","pid1_env",
    ProcessCommandLine has "/.ssh/id_","ssh_key",
    ProcessCommandLine has "/.kube/config","kube",
    ProcessCommandLine has "/.npmrc","npm",
    ProcessCommandLine has "/.docker/config.json","docker",
    "")
| summarize
    DistinctTargets = dcount(Target),
    Targets = make_set(Target, 10),
    SampleCmds = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by DeviceName, AccountName, InitiatingProcessId, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, bin(Timestamp, WindowMin)
| where DistinctTargets >= 3
| order by LastSeen desc

2980.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Cloud Atlas activity in the second half of 2025 and early 2026: new tools and a
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("fixed.ps1", "termsrv.dll", "winrar.exe", "video.vbs", "googleearth.ps1", "fodhelper.exe", "rdp_new.ps1", "gen.vbs", "writetoschedulergeneratekey.vbs", "run.vbs", "writetoschedulerrunssh.vbs", "kill.vbs", "writetoschedulerkillssh.vbs", "libcrypto.dll", "syruntime.dll") or FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\Documents\", "C:\Windows\ime", "C:\Windows\System32\ime", "C:\Windows\pla", "C:\Windows\inf"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("C:\Users\Public\Documents\", "C:\Windows\ime", "C:\Windows\System32\ime", "C:\Windows\pla", "C:\Windows\inf", "C:\Windows\migration", "C:\Windows\System32\timecontrolsvc", "C:\Windows\SKB") or FileName in~ ("fixed.ps1", "termsrv.dll", "winrar.exe", "video.vbs", "googleearth.ps1", "fodhelper.exe", "rdp_new.ps1", "gen.vbs", "writetoschedulergeneratekey.vbs", "run.vbs", "writetoschedulerrunssh.vbs", "kill.vbs", "writetoschedulerkillssh.vbs", "libcrypto.dll", "syruntime.dll"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

title: BadIIS-style Native Module Dropped Into IIS Path by Non-Installer Process
id: a3c0f1c8-8b62-4f1d-9c4e-d70e5c0e1f12
description: Detects file writes of DLL or EXE payloads into IIS-served directories (\inetsrv\, \inetpub\wwwroot\bin\) by a process that is NOT msiexec / TrustedInstaller / appcmd / drvinst. Aligns with Cisco Talos BadIIS commodity variant (May 2026) whose modules drop into IIS module paths and carry 'demo.pdb' strings.
references:
  - https://blog.talosintelligence.com/the-art-of-being-ungovernable/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1505.004
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1036.005

  product: windows
detection:
  selection_paths:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\inetsrv\'
      - '\inetpub\wwwroot\bin\'
      - '\inetpub\custerr\'
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.dll'
      - '.exe'

let lookback = 7d;
let bucket = 1h;
let BadIISSignals = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| where csMethod in~ ("GET","HEAD","POST")
| summarize Total = count(),
           Status503 = countif(scStatus == 503),
           Status3xx = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           DistinctClients = dcount(cIP),
           DistinctURIs = dcount(csUriStem),
           SampleUserAgents = make_set(csUserAgent, 5),
           SampleReferers = make_set(csReferer, 5)
           by Computer, sSiteName, bin(TimeGenerated, bucket)
| extend PctErr503 = round((Status503 * 100.0) / Total, 2),
         PctRedirect = round((Status3xx * 100.0) / Total, 2)
| where (Status503 >= 50 and PctErr503 >= 20) or (Status3xx >= 100 and PctRedirect >= 40);
let Baseline = W3CIISLog
| where TimeGenerated between (ago(30d) .. ago(lookback))
| summarize BaselineTotal = count(),
           BaselineRedirect = countif(scStatus between (300 .. 399)),
           Baseline503 = countif(scStatus == 503)
           by Computer, sSiteName
| extend BaselinePctRedirect = round((BaselineRedirect * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2),
         BaselinePctErr503 = round((Baseline503 * 100.0) / BaselineTotal, 2);
BadIISSignals
| join kind=leftouter Baseline on Computer, sSiteName
| where PctRedirect >= (coalesce(BaselinePctRedirect, 0.0) * 3) or PctErr503 >= (coalesce(BaselinePctErr503, 0.0) * 3)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, sSiteName, Total, Status503, Status3xx, PctErr503, PctRedirect, BaselinePctRedirect, BaselinePctErr503, DistinctClients, DistinctURIs, SampleUserAgents, SampleReferers
| order by TimeGenerated desc
